title: VIAGO Flyer Template Registry Contract
description: Contract version 1 for the received Version 1 renderer. Array order is behavioral: first category occurrence sets category order; template order is preserved; the first template overall is the initial template; and the first template in a selected category becomes that category's default.

version.description: Existing runtime-registry format version. Contract versioning is independent and lives in this schema filename/$id.

normalizedCoordinate.description: Finite normalized fraction of Canvas width or height.

positiveNormalizedSize.description: Finite positive normalized fraction of Canvas width or height.

color.description: Hex CSS color supported by the Version 1 contract.

shape.description: circle uses Canvas ellipse and is elliptical when w and h differ.

case.description: upper invokes the renderer's explicit uppercasing branch; none preserves entered case.

tracking.description: Finite multiplier of font pixels. Omission resolves through ?? to 0.02.

wrap.description: Omission is falsy and therefore disables wrapping.

maxLines.description: When wrap is true, omission or zero resolves through || to 3; contract values must be positive. Ignored when wrap is false.

lineHeight.description: Finite multiplier. Omission resolves through ?? to 1.15.

vAlign.description: Omission means y is the final line baseline and earlier lines stack upward.

category.description: Exact case-sensitive category. New non-empty categories are compatible with Version 1.

art.description: Relative same-origin production asset path; convention requires art/<id>.jpg.
